violation_target.vulnerability_type: Inconsistent Taxed Fees and Transferable Amount

preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some MANU tokens to initiate transfer
Contract must have at least 3 token holders (including attacker) for the reward distribution to trigger

violation_target.exploit_hint: The vulnerability is in the tax calculation and distribution logic. When a transfer occurs, the contract calculates a tax (tLiquidity) and distributes it to existing token holders. However, the same tax amount is also subtracted from total supply and added to marketing_address, creating an inconsistency. To exploit: 1. Ensure there are at least 3 token holders (create multiple addresses if needed). 2. Transfer tokens between two attacker-controlled addresses. 3. The tax distribution will credit the attacker's third address with rewards while also burning tokens from total supply, causing the attacker's relative ownership to increase. Repeat transfers to accumulate more tokens.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract has inconsistent tax handling where the same tax amount is both burned from total supply and distributed to holders. When there are at least 3 token holders, transfers trigger distribution of the tax to other holders. By controlling multiple addresses and transferring between them, an attacker can receive tax rewards while the total supply decreases, increasing their relative ownership.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Acquire initial MANU tokens. 2. Create two additional addresses and make them token holders. 3. Transfer tokens between attacker-controlled addresses to trigger tax distribution. 4. The third address receives rewards from each transfer. 5. Repeat to accumulate tokens. 6. Consolidate to show profit.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Use deal() to give attacker initial MANU tokens. 2. Create alt1 and alt2 addresses. 3. Transfer small amounts to alt1 and alt2 to add them to _accounts array. 4. Perform multiple transfers between attacker, alt1, and alt2. 5. Each transfer will distribute tax to the third address. 6. Transfer all tokens back to attacker to demonstrate profit.

Options: 1) Get tokens in a way that creates buy history, 2) Use pancakePair transfers, 3) Be excluded from fee (but we can't as attacker). Actually, deal() might not create proper buy history. Need to simulate a buy from pancakePair.
